run_point_cloud_from_camera: run the pybullet script to generate a 3D point cloud from camera RGB and depth images
create_ray_from_pixel: create a 3D ray from camera position through a given screen pixel coordinate using getRayFromTo
get_camera_image_buffers: get RGB and depth image buffers from the pybullet simulator camera using getCameraImage
create_multibody_point_cloud: create multibody sphere objects at 3D point cloud positions reconstructed from depth buffer data
add_debug_lines: add debug lines in the pybullet visualizer to connect 3D corner points of the camera frustum
